title: Read verified dedicated Bing properties as permissioned discovery observations

source.ref: Owner-requested search integration; Microsoft official JSON/HTTP, OAuth and RankAndTrafficStats reference verified2026-10-26

detail: Real fixed-host JSON/HTTP GET adapter uses only Webmaster.read Bearer credentials from the server broker. Fresh current Space editor access, discovery_coaching consent and exact connection binding gate every provider request and result. It permits only a server-owned dedicated canonical HTTPS root property, rejects shared app hosts and page-only scope, and checks GetUserSites exact Url plus IsVerified before GetRankAndTrafficStats. Two GETs maximum, no retry, 8s/1MiB per call, 5000-row cap and31day selection bound; HTTP429returns honest throttling. Only selected aggregate clicks/impressions are retained; credentials, verification codes and other sites are discarded. Bing totals span search verticals including Chat and are not AI citations, unique people or conversions. Provider timestamps bound freshness; reporting completeness and calendar bucket boundaries remain unknown. No new schema or provider mutation. Root-owned encrypted OAuth broker, ready custom-domain mapping, runtime cooldown and review UI consume this seam separately; live credential/provider acceptance is not established by mocked tests. LIVE-1335 broader scope remains open.

verify.note: Executes actual adapter/common permission gate/evidence validator with inert provider responses; proves verified scope, no preauthorization read, no statistics for unverified property and mid-flight revocation discard.
